messages:
sam: Noticing /v1/generate (EU) p95 jumped ~60ms around 03:40 UTC after we shifted routing weights. p50 unchanged. p99 moved a little. Can we get a per-path breakdown?
marta: Same. Flat median but mid-tail up suggests some requests hitting a slower execution path. Could be a connector or throttled worker group.
devon: We recently enabled the "small-payload multiplex" path on a subset of nodes. If a fraction of traffic now goes to that path and it has occasional queueing, p95 will move without p50 moving. We need a cheap way to show distribution shape per routing-tag.
sam: Proposal: in the console, add an inline mini-heatmap (bucketed histogram) next to p50/p95 that shows percent of requests per latency bucket for the last 5m. Also show `sample_count` and `variant_pct` (percent of endpoint traffic hitting that tag).
lia: UX constraints: keep the dashboard compact. Mini-heatmap collapsed by default; expand on hover. Show a clear legend and toggle between buckets and tdigest-CDF overlay. If showing variant_pct, use a small ring chart, not raw numbers.
devon: Backend: we'll emit tdigest+bucketed histogram per (endpoint,route_tag,1m). Note: merging tdigests from many minute windows with decay can change tail behavior. We should document merge semantics (we use simple sum-merge, no bias correction). Add `percentile_method` metadata with values like "tdigest-merged-1m" or "histogram-1m".
sam: API idea: `GET /metrics/query?endpoint=/v1/generate&window=5m&group_by=route_tag&metrics=p50,p95&include=histogram,cdf,meta`. `meta` contains sample_count, variant_pct, percentile_method, histogram_buckets. Keep response small for collapsed view; fetch details on expand.
marta: Also request: add a computed SLI in console: p95_over_p50_ratio. If ratio > 3 (configurable) surface a hint "mid-tail growth". That helps non-experts spot disproportionate tails.
devon: Alert suggestion: fire when (p95 > baseline_p95 * 1.35 AND variant_pct >= 0.05 AND sample_count >= 300) OR (p95_over_p50_ratio > 4 AND sample_count >= 200). That avoids noisy alerts from tiny cohorts.
lia: Tooltip copy for ratio: "p95/p50 ratio highlights mid-tail growth; higher values mean more requests are slower than typical." Keep it one sentence.
telemetry-bot: telemetry: emitted tdigest+histogram for /v1/generate grouped by route_tag at 2024-11-12T03:45Z.
sam: One more: when we roll out routing weight changes, console should optionally show an "expected impact" preview based on historical route_tag percentiles and the new weight mix. Could be a simple weighted average projection to catch obvious regressions before deploy.
devon: I'll add tdigest emission for each route_tag and a small service to simulate weighted projections. Sam, can you draft the API shape for `include=histogram,cdf,meta`? Lia, can you mock the mini-heatmap? We'll feature-flag it behind `ui.histogram_mini` and test in staging with synthetic shifts.
marta: Sounds good. Action items captured. We'll review in the dashboard sync next Tues. Thanks all.
